'''Chapter 100''' is titled "The Legend Has Begun".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] celebrate among a huge pile of treasure tumbling out of a [[Jolly Roger]]'s grinning mouth, a sparkling sea behind them.

==Short Summary==
[[Smoker]] manages to capture [[Buggy]], [[Alvida]] and the rest in mere seconds using a net made of [[Seastone]] for [[Devil Fruit]] users. When he finally gets a hold on [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and is ready to finish him off, a mysterious man named [[Monkey D. Dragon|Dragon]] stops Smoker and a huge storm suddenly starts. The storm helps Luffy, [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Sanji]] escape to the ship and head to the [[Grand Line]], where they vow to accomplish their dreams.

==Long Summary==
A [[Monkey D. Dragon|mysterious figure]] roams the streets of [[Loguetown]] as the storm pours down. Alongside the figure, words are spoken about how change cannot be stopped. The man says "[[pirate|Pirate King]]?" and then adds afterwards "not a bad idea".

[[Buggy]] gets up after being struck by lightning, angry that [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] escaped. When [[Cabaji]] questions why he is still alive, Buggy states he refuses to die here. [[Alvida]] points out the growing [[Marines|Marine]] problem. Boasting how Luffy's [[Going Merry|ship]] should be burned down by now, Buggy uses his car mode and heads off to the harbor, closely followed by Alvida who takes off her sandals, and slide down a ramp to follow. However, they are caught by [[Smoker]]. The Marines succeeded in catching the [[Buggy Pirates]] and Alvida. Smoker then chases after Luffy, while Alvida comments on how her [[Devil Fruit]] powers do not work on the net. Buggy states it is made of [[Seastone]] and the Marines have developed it to capture Devil Fruit users.

At the harbor, [[Richie]] and [[Mohji]] are in trouble, the rain prevents them from setting fire to the [[Going Merry]]. Mohji is startled as Usopp arrives, causing him to slip over and knock himself out while Richie is distracted by an egg launched out by the boy's [[Usopp's Arsenal/Ginga Pachinko|slingshot]], while the marksman and [[Nami]] arrive back to the Going Merry.

Elsewhere, [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], [[Sanji]], and Luffy race towards the ship followed by the Marines. Ahead, [[Tashigi]] calls Zoro out and states he lied to her. She states she will take Zoro's [[Famous Blade]]s and [[Wado Ichimonji]] away from him. As the pair break into a fight, Sanji yells at Zoro for attacking a woman but Luffy grabs Sanji and continue on towards the harbor, leaving Zoro behind. Tashigi is easily beaten, knocked against the wall with Zoro's [[sword]] at her throat, Zoro states he will never lose his sword. As Zoro begins to run after Luffy and Sanji, Tashigi is outraged that she wasn't killed and demands he tell her why he refuses to kill her, believing it to be because she is a woman. Zoro yells at her, telling her to stop imitating his [[Kuina|dead friend]] and the two break into a childish argument.

Smoker catches up to Luffy and Sanji and blocks the way to the harbor. Smoker grabs Luffy causing Sanji to leap into action, but with no effect to Smoker because of his Devil Fruit, the [[Moku Moku no Mi]]. Smoker uses White Blow and hits Sanji to a building, Luffy tried to fight back with one blow but ultimately failed, due to Smoker's ability. Losing very easily, as Smoker goes to throw the finishing blow, a mysterious man called Dragon appears. The [[World Government]] is apparently looking for him. Stating the world is "waiting for our answer", a gust of wind breaks out.

Everyone is blown away from where they were, including Luffy with Zoro and Sanji. As the crew escape, Smoker demands to know why, Dragon states he sees no reason to stop a man's destiny. At the harbor, Nami and Usopp urge the others to hurry on board the Going Merry quickly. Smoker declares he will go after Luffy, Tashigi states she will chase after Zoro. On the sea, Buggy tells his crew to chase after Luffy, and that it is time he returned to the [[Grand Line]].

Finally, away from Loguetown and safely at sea, the Straw Hats spot the lighthouse signaling the way to the Grand Line. They declare their vows and dreams and prepare themselves for the next step in their journey.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] battles and defeats [[Tashigi]].
*The [[Marines]] developed [[Seastone#Restraints|special nets]] able to cancel [[Devil Fruit]] powers.
*[[Usopp]] bought some goggles.
*A man named [[Monkey D. Dragon|Dragon]] saves [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and his [[Straw Hat Pirates|crew]] from [[Smoker]].
*Smoker and his men decide to chase after Luffy in the [[Grand Line]].
*[[Buggy]] decides to go to the Grand Line.
*The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] finally set off for the Grand Line.
*This is the last chapter of the [[Loguetown Arc]] and the [[East Blue Saga]].

==Trivia==
*In its original ''[[Weekly Shonen Jump]]'' printing, this chapter's [[Color Spread]] celebrated not only the [[One Piece (Manga)|manga's]] one-hundredth chapter, but the official announcement of [[One Piece (Anime)|Toei's animated adaptation]].
**More than twenty years later, the Color Spread would be homaged by the "dual" spread for [[Chapter 999]] and [[Chapter 1000]], which incorporates all the crewmates the Straw Hats have recruited in the [[Grand Line]] till that point in the story.
*In the chapter's initial publishing in ''[[Weekly Shonen Jump]]'', the first story page was printed in full color.
*The quote at the beginning of the chapter, attributed to [[Gol D. Roger]], refers to three things that "cannot be stopped": [[Inherited Will|inherited will]], [[Dream|people's dreams]], and the ebb and flow of the ages. These would all later be referenced as the titles to chapters [[Chapter 145|145]], [[Chapter 225|225]] and [[Chapter 1121|1121]]. (and their respective volumes, [[Volume 16]], [[Volume 24|24]] and [[Volume 110|110]]).
